request: Escaping backslashes inside the quoted string literals of a matcher expression doubles each backslash and leaves every other character untouched, including non-ASCII text: r.sub == '香港' and r.obj == "café" come out unchanged, and 'naïve\1' becomes 'naïve\\1'.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: preserve non-ASCII literals in EscapeStringLiterals (#1746)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > util/util_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestEscapeStringLiterals)$' ./util >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
